details:
Having this super annoying problem for a year now with two different headsets (Index + Quest 3) where after hanging out for a certain time inside of an instance, everything starts to lag out and I lose ability to both communicate via voice chat + not listening to anyone else.

From what I looked around, this problem apparently is still present for a lot of players and despite the moderators/developers closing down posts with the "fixed" tag, there's absolutely no guide/fix that has been able to help me out as well as for many of these other people.

I have so far tried reinstalling the game, clearing registry, setting options back to default, talking with my provider to see if there was any kind of issue with the process, reinstalling windows + VR software etc., Using default models, setting safety options to max, amongst many others suggested, nothing works.

I am not using any software that changes my audio input/output as well and I can provide further information about my system if someone is willing to please help, this problem currently obliges me to have to restart an instance every 5 minutes which just makes the game unplayable. Any information, help is much appreciated.
title: Audio Cutting out + Lag
